scope: Persisted round diff and verifier rendering only; no orchestrator/API changes
plan_requirements: docs/PLAN.md:151 per-round diff summary and verification table
behavior: Reads existing round.patch through open_regular; bounded regular UTF-8 files only; no symlink traversal.
Keeps both kept and reverted diffs, exact bytes/SHA-256, parsed diff summary or explicit unavailable summary.
Reports each round's own verification checks, notes, before/after, timing, loss delta, and target state; unknown values stay unknown.
Preserves final kept summary independently of later reverted candidates.
Preserves per-round provenance and visibly labels offline fixtures; renders requested_information and supplement_request.
Diff text is HTML escaped and every rendered GB/percentage remains backed by report JSON.
round_download_contract: Front-end may download complete row.diff only when diff_status=available; no new API endpoint.
limitations: No live model or GPU round was executed; focused scenarios are labeled offline fixtures.
This does not validate patch effectiveness or change any numerical/acceptance threshold.
